slices.focus: A new annual tracker reveals which parts of the program are genuinely transferable and which still depend on Colleen personally.
slices.summary: Colleen replaces her catch-all booking sheet with a formal annual tracker that breaks down the year by season, school type, package, volunteer lead, and likely rebooking. The tracker confirms genuine seasonal spread but also exposes uncomfortable truths: one package still depends heavily on her because she handles all the transitions and pivots. She commits to creating an explicitly volunteer version of that package and using the tracker as an operational tool, not just a evidence collection device.
open_loops: Simplify the most dependent package before training volunteers on it
Draft a clearly labeled volunteer version with visible differences from full version
Define success behaviorally: fewer rescue interventions, more confident handoffs, higher share of visits led without her
decisions: Colleen replaced her old catch-all booking spreadsheet with a formal annual tracker for the museum's school program.
